name: g20 aggregation — single-leg GROUP BY ships verbatim to the arango leg (docs per role)
_note: groups by `role` (present in BOTH the CI fixtures and the full local corpus) and asserts min_rows instead of exact values — CI's seed.py loads 3 ci-fixture docs, the full corpus only exists locally
sparql: PREFIX c: <urn:arango-sparql:concept#> SELECT ?role (COUNT(?d) AS ?n) WHERE { ?d a c:Document ; c:role ?role } GROUP BY ?role
